@NiagaraType
@NiagaraAction(name = "execute", flags = Flags.ASYNC)
public class BEngineThreadExecutor extends BComponent
{
  public void doExecute()
  {
    try
    {
      Thread.sleep(10000L);
    }
    catch (InterruptedException ex) {}
  }
}
